formName: Step 2 - Eligibility Step for  Water Licence Application
formDescription: This step has a set of questions/fields to determine if the applicant is eligible to apply for a water licence. Also there are other fields to  check whether the application is part of clean energy project within British Columbia.

AnswerOnJob_eligible.title: Are you eligible to apply for a water licence?
AnswerOnJob_eligible.description: Applicant is eligible to apply if they have ownership or are entitled to possession of a land or mine in British Columbia, OR  acting as an agent for a municipality, regional district, improvement district, development district, BC Hydro or water users' community OR  a holder of a certificate of public convenience and necessity issued under the Public Utilities Act

AnswerOnJob_clean-energy.title: Is this application related to a clean energy project that received a new Energy Purchase Agreement from BC Hydro between 2024-present?
AnswerOnJob_clean-energy.description: The purpose of this application must be related with clean energy project like wind or solar activities

EligibilityExplanation.title: Please provide an explanation for your eligibility to apply for a water licence:
EligibilityExplanation.description: Applicant must provide a brief explanation of their eligibility to apply for a water licence.
